parameters.query:
SELECT 
  wr.id as waste_record_id,
  wr.waste_date,
  wr.quantity_wasted,
  wr.waste_unit,
  wr.cost_wasted,
  wr.waste_reason,
  wr.notes,
  wr.created_at as waste_created_at,
  fi.name as food_item_name,
  fi.description as food_description,
  fi.price as food_price,
  fi.category as food_category,
  u.id as user_id,
  u.name as user_name,
  u.email as user_email,
  u.phone as user_phone,
  r.name as restaurant_name,
  r.address as restaurant_address,
  r.phone as restaurant_phone,
  r.email as restaurant_email
FROM waste_records wr
INNER JOIN food_items fi ON wr.food_item_id = fi.id
INNER JOIN restaurants r ON wr.restaurant_id = r.id
INNER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
WHERE DATE(wr.waste_date) = CURDATE()
ORDER BY wr.waste_date DESC, r.name ASC;
